tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Quo violet. Primary buttons, selected answers, the app icon tile. White text on it passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Links and violet text on surface; pressed state and the lip under primary buttons in light theme.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected-row fill, quiet highlight behind brand-strong or ink text.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and the renewal terms helper lines on surface. Never lighter than this for pricing text.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Deep indigo ground for hero bands, game tiles and share cards. Use white or spark text on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, answer options, sheets.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card and input borders, progress track.

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: The spark above Quo's head: XP, streaks, the one highlight per screen. Ink text on it, never white.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Verbal skill, streak flame, playful accents. Decorative only, not for errors.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Spatial skill, goal-complete fills. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Numbers skill, streak freeze. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Correct-round text and icons on surface (training only; the test never shows right or wrong).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions such as Cancel plan confirm text.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: The score estimate on the report and share card. One per screen.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Questions, report copy, and the renewal terms line at the paywall.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Prices, button labels, emphasis inside body.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper text and chart labels. Not for billing terms.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow labels and stat chips.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between answer options.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the page side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero and band padding; the pitch of the spark pattern.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, answer options, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, game tiles, sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Progress bars, stat chips, badges.

tokens.name: lip
tokens.usage: The solid lip under primary buttons. It collapses to 0 on press.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Sheets and the paywall card only.
